# VCode

> VCode is a Czech digital product brand. We build dependable applications for mobility, public situational awareness, health, bookings and organisational management.

Canonical website: https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/
English website: https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/en/
Public source: https://github.com/voldzi/vcode
Support: mailto:podpora@zeleznalady.cz

## Products

- [APSYD](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/apsyd/): a platform for secure assessment and organisational workflows.
- [PAS](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/pas/): a private iOS application for ÚVN supporting safe nursing workflows, structured clinical entry and patient-context work.
- [Jízda](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/jizda/): journey logging, navigation, vehicles, passengers, costs and secure communication for iPhone and Apple Watch.
- [COP Mobile](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/cop-mobile/): mobile situational awareness, field reporting, alerts and secure communication.
- [COP](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/cop/): public situation map for traffic, warnings, infrastructure and route planning.
- [NEST](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/nest/): turn-based strategy game for iPhone and iPad with local play, an on-device AI opponent and Game Center multiplayer; preparing for App Store release.
- [Šibenice](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/sibenice/): Czech word game for iPhone and Apple TV; in preparation.
- [Městem hrou](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/mestem-hrou/): city exploration game connecting walks and playful discoveries.
- [Masáže](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/masaze/): services, live availability and massage booking.
- [Studio Balance](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/studio-balance/): class schedules, booking and client self-service.
- [STRATOS](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/stratos/): a family of private applications for finance, portfolio oversight, project delivery, architecture and governed knowledge.
- [Budget & Contract](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/budget-contract/): private financial planning, procurement, contracts and suppliers.
- [Executive Center](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/executive-center/): private management and portfolio overview.
- [ProjectFlow](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/projectflow/): private project delivery, phases, tasks and stage gates.
- [ArchFlow](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/archflow/): private needs, goals, regulations and council decisions.
- [AI Knowledge Base (AKB)](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/akb/): separately released STRATOS-family service for governed document knowledge, source-linked answers and permission-based access.
- [Kalorické tabulky](https://vcode.zeleznalady.cz/aplikace/kaloricke-tabulky/): Czech food diary, recipes, offline logging and nutritional context.
